Preheat oven to 325°F. Line three 8-inch round pans with parchment. 2. Whisk dry ingredients together. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk wet ingredients together. 4. Add dry ingredients to wet. Whisk until smooth. 5. Let batter sit for 5 minutes, then whisk again for 10 seconds. 6. Divide evenly between pans. 7. Bake at 325°F for 25 minutes, until centers are set. 8. Cool 10-15 minutes in pans, then remove/cool completely. Filling Ingredients 120 g butter of choice (3 sticks) 60 g heavy cream of choice (~1/4 cup) 120 g powdered sugar (1 cup) 20 g light corn syrup (1 tbsp) 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ⅛ tsp fine sea salt Instructions 1. Heat butter and heavy cream together until fully melted and smooth. 2. Whisk in powdered sugar until completely smooth and glossy. 3. Add syrup, vanilla, and salt.  4. Let sit until cool & slightly thickened. Buttercream Ingredients 340 g (3 sticks) butter of choice 520 g (4 cups) powdered sugar 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ¼ tsp fine sea salt 40 g (3 tbsp) heavy cream of choice Instructions 1. Beat butter for 3-5 minutes until light and fluffy. 2. Add powdered sugar and mix for 5-7 minutes. 3. Add vanilla bean paste and salt. 4. Slowly stream in heavy cream and mix on low Assembly 1. Level cake layers if needed. 2. Pipe a buttercream dam around the edge of each layer. 3. Fill the center with lava filling. 4. Stack and repeat with remaining layers.

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Vulcão de ninho com Nutella  Ingredientes massa: 4 ovos 1 xícara (chá 250 ml ) de açúcar  200 ml de óleo  1 xícara de leite em pó  1 xícara de água  2 e 1/2 xícaras de farinha de trigo  1 colher (sopa) de fermento químico em pó  Preparo: Coloque no liquidificador todos os ingredientes exceto o trigo e o fermento. Bata por aproximadamente 2 minutos. Acrescente o trigo e o fermento por último e bata rapidamente (no liquidificador mesmo) só para misturar. Passe para forma untada com margarina e eleve para assar em forno pré aquecido, a 180 graus até dourar levemente em cima. Faça o teste do palito para se certificar que está assado corretamente. O tempo de forno é aproximadamente 40 minutos. Desenforme o bolo morno.  Ingredientes cobertura: 1 leite condensado  1 creme de leite  3 colheres (sopa) de leite em pó  Preparo: Coloque todos os ingredientes na panela e leve ao fogo médio, mexendo sempre até ferver. Depois mexa por mais 1 minuto e desligue. Depois de frio é só jogar sobre o bolo e colocar Nutella a gosto.  #campograndems #bolodeninho #receitafácil

Le secret du Gâteau Volcan : Moelleux et irrésistible ! 🌋🍫. 1.La base : Battre les œufs avec le sucre et la vanille jusqu’à ce que le mélange blanchisse. 2.Les liquides : Ajouter l’huile tout en continuant de battre, puis verser le lait. 3.Le secret de la texture : Incorporer la farine (environ 300g) petit à petit. Attention : la quantité peut varier selon la qualité de votre farine (certaines absorbent plus que d’autres !). 4.La touche finale : Ajouter le cacao et la levure chimique en même temps que la farine. 5.	Le montage : Verser la pâte dans un moule de 27 cm de diamètre, puis déposer délicatement au centre la crème pâtissière maison. 6.	La cuisson : Enfourner à 180°C pendant 40 minutes. Allumer uniquement le bas au début, puis le haut en fin de cuisson pour dorer. 7.	La déco : Une touche de zeste de citron et du chocolat râpé pour le contraste des saveurs. 🍋🍫 Bon appétit ! ❤️ #GâteauVolcan #CakeChocolat #PatisserieMaison #RecetteFacile

videos.caption: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake  Ingredients: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter - 6oz semi-sweet or bittersweet chocolate, chopped - 2 large eggs - 2 large egg yolks - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/4 cup sugar - 1/4 tsp salt - 2 tbsp flour - 1 tsp espresso powder Bake at 450 F for 8-10 minutes in ramekins Makes 4-6 servings (depends on ramekin size) Instructions: Grease your ramekins well and dust  them with a little flour or cocoa powder. Melt the butter and  chopped chocolate together until  completely smooth over a double boiler. Or you can do this in the microwave in  short intervals, stirring between each one. In a separate bowl, whisk together  the eggs, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and  salt. Whisk until everything is smooth  and slightly thicker and lighter in color. The extra egg yolks help give the lava  cake a richer, more custardy center. Add the flour and espresso powder into chocolate mixture, and mix just until  combined. The espresso powder isn’t there to  make it taste like coffee—it just helps  enhance the chocolate flavor.  Slowly pour the melted chocolate mixture  into the egg mixture and whisk until  smooth, but make sure not to overmix. Divide the batter evenly between  four to six ramekins, depending on  their size. Bake at 450°F for about 8 to 10 minutes. The edges should be set, but the centers  should still look slightly soft and jiggly. And this is where you really don’t want  to overbake them. Let them rest for a minute, then carefully  flip them onto a plate. #chocolate #cake #dessert #easyrecipe #easydessert

videos.caption: Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie
